title: Georgic
summary: GEOR'GIC, noun [Gr. rustic; and labor.] A rural poem; a poetical composition on the subject of husbandry, containing rules for cultivating lands, in a poetical dress; as the Georgics of Virgil. GEOR'G

inlines.v: GEOR'GIC, noun [Gr. rustic; and labor.] A rural poem; a poetical composition on the subject of husbandry, containing rules for cultivating lands, in a poetical dress; as the Georgics of Virgil. GEOR'GIC, adjective Relating to the doctrine of agriculture and rural affairs. GEORGIUM SIDUS. [See Herschel.]
